record.question: The disadvantage of a half-wave rectifier is that the
options: diodes must have a high power rating
record.explanation: Half-wave rectifiers conduct for only half the cycle, producing a pulsating output that contains significant ripple voltage, making filtering more difficult than in full-wave rectifiers.
